description: This Java class 'ValueLinkApi' implements encryption, key management, and communication with the ValueLink third-party payment system, including methods for key generation, encryption/decryption, and request handling.

classes.name: ValueLinkApi
classes.description: Main class providing encryption, key management, and communication with ValueLink payment system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ValueLinkApi, optionally reloading keys.

methods.name: encryptPin
methods.description: Encrypts a PIN using configured keys for transmission.

methods.name: decryptPin
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted PIN received from ValueLink.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request to the ValueLink system and returns the response map.

methods.name: outputKeyCreation
methods.description: Outputs generated public/private keys and KEK for manual database update.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Creates a new Diffie-Hellman key pair based on ValueLink parameters.

methods.name: generateKek
methods.description: Generates a Key Encryption Key (KEK) using Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: getValueLinkPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key provided by ValueLink.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for the merchant.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Generates a new Merchant Working Key (MWK).

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Generates an MWK from a given DES key byte array.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Generates an MWK from a pre-generated DESede SecretKey.

methods.name: encryptViaKek
methods.description: Encrypts data using the KEK.

methods.name: decryptViaKek
methods.description: Decrypts data using the KEK.

methods.name: getDateString
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted for ValueLink.

methods.name: getWorkingKeyIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current working key index.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into ValueLink's string format.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a ValueLink amount string into BigDecimal.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code, currently fixed to '840'.

methods.name: getInitialRequestMap
methods.description: Creates initial request parameters for ValueLink transactions.

methods.name: getGenericValue
methods.description: Retrieves cached ValueLink key data from the database.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Clears cached keys to force reloading.

methods.name: getDHParameterSpec
methods.description: Creates Diffie-Hellman parameters from configured prime and generator.

methods.name: cryptoViaKek
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption using KEK with random IV.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Cipher instance for DESede/CBC/NoPadding.

methods.name: getPinCheckSum
methods.description: Calculates a simple checksum byte for a PIN.

methods.name: getRandomBytes
methods.description: Generates a byte array of random bytes.

methods.name: getMwkKey
methods.description: Retrieves the SecretKey object for the MWK.

methods.name: getKekKey
methods.description: Retrieves the SecretKey object for the KEK.

methods.name: getDesEdeKey
methods.description: Creates a SecretKey object from raw byte array for DESede.

methods.name: getMwk
methods.description: Retrieves the MWK as a byte array.

methods.name: getKek
methods.description: Retrieves the KEK as a byte array.

methods.name: getPrivateKeyBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the private key bytes.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTML response from ValueLink into a map.

methods.name: parseHistoryResponse
methods.description: Parses historical data from ValueLink response.

methods.name: getByteRange
methods.description: Extracts a subarray of bytes from a given byte array.

methods.name: copyBytes
methods.description: Copies source bytes into target array at specified position.
